avis.titre: i cannot believe how well this worked for me!
avis.texte: I am SHOCKED that this went so well for me. I was fortunate to receive this complimentary from MDSolarSciences, but upon receiving it, I panicked over the filters used. However, my skin...did great with this? I am very sensitive, so I am exceedingly pleased to be typing that!Now, I will tell you some honest pros and cons, that are a bit wrapped up into one with this product. First, it claims to give a glow, and wow - it DOES. It's a gorgeous product with no glitter, but it looks stunning on. Like you have a natural radiance to your skin. However! It's got a universal tint. Ayyy! I have a very fair skin tone, so it looked a bit off on me. It worked great as a primer though, so I added a lighter concealer to the center of my face, then set with powder. The end look was perfect.Basically: if it's a perfect match for your skin (i'm going to say NC 20ish?), you can slap this on and go, and your skin will look phenomenal and be protected from the sun. If you are more fair, or more deep I suspect, you may need to add a bit of makeup on top. But yes, it's friendly towards makeup.Not drying, not uncomfortable, no stinging. Frankly I am blown away by how easy it was to wear.5 stars, I would definitely recommend this product!
